# Select Dropdown

Select Dropdown fields allow publishers to choose a single item from a dropdown list.

:::note
The following examples use a field named `select_field`. This should be replaced with your field name.
:::

<Tabs groupId="template-language">
<TabItem value="twig" label="Twig">

```twig
{{ entry.select_field }}

{% for value, label in entry.select_field.options %}
    {{ label }} - {{ value }}
{% endfor %}

{% for value, label in entry.select_field.selected %}
    {{ label }} - {{ value }}
{% endfor %}
```

</TabItem>
<TabItem value="blade" label="Blade">

```php
{{ $entry->select_field }}

@foreach($entry->select_field->options as $value => $label)
    {{ $label }} - {{ $value }}
@endforeach

@foreach($entry->select_field->selected as $value => $label)
    {{ $label }} - {{ $value }}
@endforeach
```

</TabItem>
</Tabs>

## Parameters


<Tabs groupId="template-language">
<TabItem value="twig" label="Twig">

```twig
{{ entry.select_field.parameters({markup: 'ul'}) }}
```

</TabItem>
<TabItem value="blade" label="Blade">

```php
{{ $entry->select_field->parameters(['markup' => 'ul']) }}
```

</TabItem>
</Tabs>
